text:
Nathan MacKinnon won the Rocket Richard last season with 53 goals and 127 points, and he's somehow been better on a per-minute basis this year: 30 points in 19 games, 4.58 points per 60, above even our generous range for him. Nothing about it looks fluky. His shooting (14.7%) is exactly normal and the team's on-ice finishing is right on the chances.

He does it the way he always has. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him in the 99th percentile among forwards for primary shot assists and for chances from the slot, and Evolving-Hockey had him fifth among 401 forwards in wins above replacement, better than his goals even said.

He skipped Thursday's morning skate in Ottawa (with nobody in his spot in line rushes, the Denver Post's Corey Masisak noted, so probably nothing). Our range puts him at 104 to 135 points. At 31, the best player on a Cup contender is playing like it.
